simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֹּךְ (H8496) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תֹּךְ (tôk) means oppression First listed occurrence: Ps 10 7.

definitions.full: H8496. tok תֹּךְ II. תּוֺךְ noun masculine injury, oppression ; — absolute תֹּךְ + מִרְמָה Psa 10:7 ; 55:12 (so Gi; Baer תּוֺךְ ); תּוֺךְ , + חָמָס (gloss) 72:14 ; plural כִּים תְּכָּ אִישׁ Prov 29:13 oppressor ( ᵑ9 creditor ; compare חמסים אישׁ 2Sam 22:49 ; Psa 140:2 ; 140:5 ). — 1. תּוֺךְ see תָּוֶךְ . תְּכָּכִים see תֹּךְ . לִית תַּכְּ תִּכְלָה, see כלה . above,
definitions.rootNote: or תּוֹך ; (Psalm 72:14), from the same base as 8432 (in the sense of cutting to pieces);
